title: The first stop for exported proteins
hook: Inspect the cell and find the structure behind its function.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: Ribosomes on the rough endoplasmic reticulum make proteins into or across its membrane. Many secreted proteins begin processing there before moving through the endomembrane system.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
